conditions: This covers the explicit -export attribute for ordinary module functions.
limitations: It does not claim the listed functions are the only usable objects or deny compiler-generated exports, compiler options, dynamic calls, or function values.

triggers: Revalidate for an applicable Erlang reference correction, source revision change, identity remapping, or contradictory primary evidence.

statement: The Erlang/OTP 27.3.4 reference defines the module export attribute as a list of Name/Arity entries identifying functions defined within the module that the attribute makes visible externally.
